issues.problem: The fetched excerpt for both anchors is the IANA section, so the page text does not show If-Match or 409 directly. The IANA table does confirm 409 is section 15.5.10 and 412 is 15.5.13. From my own knowledge of RFC 9110, section 13.1.1 is If-Match and a false condition gives 412 or a 2xx. I therefore accept the claims, and the anchors are valid.
issues.suggestedFix: Optionally add #section-15.5.13 (412 Precondition Failed) as a link, since step 3 relies on 412.
